title: Oryx Training Center
description: A modern training center web application built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS. Features fully responsive UI layouts, dynamic course catalog rendering, and modular component architecture.

title: Booking MM
description: A full-featured booking and reservation platform built with React and Next.js. Integrates dynamic REST APIs for real-time availability checking and responsive Tailwind CSS UI components.

title: HMO Portfolio
description: A high-performance cinematic developer portfolio built with Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion. Features interactive 3D liquid crystal animations and bilingual localization.

title: Panda Film Engine
description: A streamlined movie exploration platform leveraging high-speed image optimization and responsive UI cards. Features real-time movie API search and dynamic client-side filtering.

title: Pi Vape E-Commerce
description: A modern e-commerce showcase featuring localized UI patterns, smooth page navigation powered by Framer Motion, and a highly responsive layout optimized for user conversion.

title: Feedback Cloud
description: A real-time customer feedback orchestration tool built with React and Firebase Firestore. Features instant form validation, live sentiment data visualization, and reactive state management.

title: Pixel Forge Studio
description: An interactive UI component laboratory exploring modern React patterns, design system tokens, and accessible, reusable component architectures with Framer Motion.

title: Task Manager App
description: A full-stack task management application with React.js frontend, Node.js backend, and MongoDB storage. Implements full CRUD operations, live state updates, and clean UI workflow.
